 IBPS RRB PO admit card 2026 released: Download officer scale 1 prelims call letter at ibps.in
 The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 for candidates appearing in the Officer Scale 1 Preliminary Examination. Students can check the complete details here to learn more.
 Curated By Akshita Jolly 
 Image: Canva 
 Nov 09, 2026
 Share
 The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has published the IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 for candidates appearing in the Officer Scale 1 Preliminary Examination.  
 Those who registered for the Common Recruitment Process for Regional Rural Banks (CRP RRBs-XV) can now download their call letters via the official website, ibps.in. The preliminary exam will be taking place on November 21 and 22, 2026. 
 The admit cards be accessed by entering the registration number or roll number along with the password or date of birth.  
 What are the steps to download the IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026? 
 Here are the steps provided below to download the IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026:  
 Visit the official IBPS website, ibps.in. 
 Open the CRP RRBs-XV section on the homepage. 
 Click on the Officer Scale 1 Preliminary Examination Call Letter 2026 link. 
 Enter your registration number or roll number. 
 Enter your password or date of birth. 
 Fill in the captcha code, if required. 
 Click on the login or submit button. 
 The IBPS RRB PO admit card will appear on the screen. 
 Download the call letter and take a printout for future reference. 
 Keep visiting the official website for more such updates and notifications.
